The main takeaway from our work is that
in models with extra dimensions, where the singlet fields live on the bulk and the Higgs fields live on the brane, there is no upper bound on M h.
in theories with extra dimensions the lightest Higg boson mass can be significantly enhanced, even if the Higgs boson is a bulk field.
the presence of extra dimensions may be a source of new physics that can enhance the upper bound for the Higgs mass in models where singlets are introduced to solve the μ problem.
